'''Durand''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who served as the [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]] of the [[Corellian Council]], the ruling body of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During a passionate debate about subsector zoning bypass regulations, an angry Councilor named [[Brecourl]] challenged Durand to a duel in front of the rest of the Council, a duel that Durand won; the incident was famously remembered as the only time someone had been killed on the floor of the [[Legislature Building]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Durand was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Corellian Legislature in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
